title: The Rocks / Placemaking NSW — New Year’s Eve 2026 public areas

facts.fact: The page dates the celebration 31 December 2026 and names free, non-ticketed waterfront sites including Dawes Point,Hickson Road Reserve,Campbells Cove and Circular Quay sectors.
facts.excerpt: This year, all vantage points will be FREE - No tickets required.
facts.location: New Year’s Eve 2026 page introduction and free public-site list; does not include private dining events

facts.fact: Entry to those public viewing areas is first-come and subject to capacity, with no pass-outs; private restaurants and rooftops use separate arrangements.
facts.excerpt: No special spots or reservations, it's first-come, first-served.
facts.location: Introduction; generic later FAQ contains mixed ticket wording and cutoff inconsistencies, which are not adopted.

notes: Official document actually captured and read on the recorded date. Raw HTML and extracted text are preserved outside Git in artifacts/maletafeliz-new-year-ten-n 12/sources-asia-london/research. The article distinguishes 31 December 2026 from 1 January 2027, current announcements from historical copy, and public places from ticketed events. Archive photographs identify places only and do not document the future celebration. No purchase, availability guarantee, personal experience or search-demand claim is made.
